name: Escape!
source:
-----The epic ADV novel about a protagonist and five girls escaping various fates. 
A heartful journey with laughter, tears and an enduring spirit. 

"Ayaka Sakuraba" is targeted by a stalker and moves in with the protagonist; 
"Madoka Misonou" feels pressure to be a good daughter who learns ikebana; 
"Nanami Aiba" has a distrust of men drilled into her by her parents. 

Numerous stories intersect, but where will they go-----

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE179289.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
——一部讲述主人公与五名女孩逃离各种命运的史诗ADV小说。
一段充满欢笑、泪水与不屈精神的温暖旅程。

“樱庭绫香”遭到跟踪狂纠缠，搬来与主人公同住；
“御园圆”承受着成为优秀女儿、学习插花的压力；
“相叶七海”被父母灌输了对男人的不信任。

无数故事彼此交汇，却将走向何方——

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE179289.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
